$comment: Hand-maintained API base URLs for providers whose models.dev entry has no
`api` field. An entry is only used when the provider speaks the
openai-completions transport; it never overrides a URL that the payload
already carries, and it never changes a provider's protocol.
Every URL below was reachability-checked (the API root answers 401/403
without a key, or 200 where the endpoint is public). Do not add a URL you
have not seen in the provider's own documentation.

openai.note: payload has no api field; URL is the documented API root

mistral.note: unused today: the provider speaks @ai-sdk/mistral, which is not OpenAI-compatible
